title: Streaming Logit Entropy
prompt:
Implement two functions for entropy from unnormalized logits.

`entropy_from_logits(logits)` receives a non-empty 1D list or NumPy array of logits and returns the natural-log entropy of the softmax distribution. Use a numerically stable log-sum-exp style computation, so large logits such as `[1000, 1000]` do not overflow.

`streaming_entropy(blocks)` receives an iterable of non-empty 1D logit blocks and returns the same entropy as if all blocks had been concatenated. Do not store all logits. Maintain a shared running max plus scaled sums so the computation uses `O(1)` extra state besides the current block.

For logits `z`, if `L = logsumexp(z)`, the entropy is `L - sum_i softmax(z)_i * z_i`. Raise `ValueError` for an empty logits vector, an empty block, or no blocks.
